title: Healthy-source arterial occurrence in matched mean TOF MRI
author: NeuroImage project
objective: Explore the retained arterial-occurrence field and distinguish original percent evidence from a project-derived threshold display.

scenes.title: Whole source arterial occurrence field
scenes.prompt: Start with full mean TOF sections and use Magnify at cursor to inspect the same physical point. Compare the mean TOF image, source arterial-occurrence percentage and thresholded 3D navigation surface. The field has no source-defined named branch labels.
scenes.note: Original population arterial-occurrence values range from 0 to 100 percent. A documented project threshold of at least 25 percent produces the display mask and its 3D surface. This calculated illustration represents population occurrence; the original probability field remains available for comparison. Source coverage, sampling and population alignment govern the appearance of small vessels.
